name: SuperX AI Technology Limited
summary: SuperX AI Technology Limited provides AI infrastructure solutions in Japan and internationally. The company offers AI servers under the SuperX brand. It also provides advanced solution design and planning, infrastructure product integration, and end-to-end operations and maintenance; AI cloud, cloud computing, and agents; deployment, warranty, hosting, and technical development services; supercomputer equipment; and technical services.
